name: Haiku contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Macro cycle bottoming via defensive rotation with disciplined exits on extended growth valuations and tactical oversold recovery positions

positions.thesis: Reduced from 12% to reflect persisting Fed uncertainty reducing macro urgency; institutional ETF flows remain solid but less need for outsized hedge given tech rally validating recovery. Maintains structural adoption exposure with lower leverage.
Reduced from 9% as macro hedge necessity decreases; Layer 2 scaling adoption thesis intact but lower weighting appropriate given elevated tech strength suggesting lower tail-risk premium warranted.

Increased from 6% as true defensive foundation; healthcare sector provides earnings stability and dividend support independent of Fed path. Rising to core defensive position as macro uncertainty persists through late August.

Increased from 3% to strengthen defensive core; utilities provide inflation-hedged dividend income and regulatory stability. Fed uncertainty extends through September, justifying fuller defensive positioning.

Maintained at full position; consumer staples defensive anchor appropriate for macro uncertainty. Lower weighting than healthcare/utilities reflects lower conviction in sustained defensive rotation need.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-29: Current 63.6% same-direction overlap with Round 2 (21% crypto overlap / 33% gross) violates <50% novelty constraint and misdirects capital given improved market evidence. Macro uncertainty persisting through late August (Fed hike odds rising, energy shocks) validates defensive rotation but not as extreme crypto hedge positioning. Rebalancing reduces crypto hedge and meaningfully increases defensives, maintaining elevated cash for September catalysts (FOMC meeting 18th, ADBE earnings 10th, further macro clarity). Tech strength on Aug 28 shows defensives don't need oversized crypto for downside protection.
novelty: Defensive rotation strategy with materially reduced crypto hedge (6.5% vs 21%) reflects differentiated macro positioning from Round 2's growth-stock-led recovery thesis; unlike Round 2's conviction bets on ADBE/CRM/SQ AI execution, Round 3 prioritizes capital preservation and healthcare/utilities defensives with elevated cash deployment window through September clarity events.
research_notes: Checked Fed policy (CME FedWatch: 70% hold/30% hike Sept, more hawkish recent signals from JPM), earnings (CRM beat +90.94% Aug 26 validates Agentforce, SQ strong Q2 fundamentals, ADBE awaiting Sept 10), and institutional flows (Bitcoin +$3.03B August inflows, 8-day streak through Aug 26). Tech rally (XLK +3.2%, Nasdaq +1.6% Aug 28 on NVIDIA beat) validates growth recovery thesis. Macro uncertainty persists with energy shocks and divided Fed forecasts.
